run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T00:19:27Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend error-rate alert is backed by the frontend's own span-metric error signals: ERROR-status spans on span_name GET /api/data and on its client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds appear from the 00:18:16–00:23:16 bucket (233.3 per 300 s, zero in the preceding bucket), peak at ~295 per 300 s around 00:26, and fall back to 0 by 00:33:16; a shorter burst of ERROR spans on POST /api/checkout and tcp.connect ran between ~00:19 and ~00:28. At 00:18:23–00:18:24 the Deployments ad and payment were rolled out with unchanged pod templates (only a kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt annotation inside the new ReplicaSets, same images/env as the scaled-to-zero ReplicaSets), and the ConfigMap flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) currently holds two switched-on fault-injection settings whose descriptions name exactly those services: adFailure = "on" ("Fail ad service") and paymentUnreachable = "on" ("Payment service is unavailable"). I therefore assess, as a hypothesis rather than a witnessed event, that those settings in flagd-config are the cause, with the ad/payment restarts as the mechanism by which the fault was applied and the frontend/checkout error bursts as its consequences. Checkout's client spans oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge errored only inside 00:18:16–00:23:16 (78.7 per 900 s, then 0), while the payment pod itself shows no error spans, served charges successfully ("Transaction complete." 00:27–00:28) and is running/ready with 0 restarts; frontend-proxy shows its own error-span increase in the same window. ad shows its own small flag-evaluation error spans, a heavy CPU-throttling and >15 s latency tail on its restarted instance, and no ERROR status on its GetAds server spans. cart, currency, email, product-catalog, quote and shipping returned only UNSET/OK span statuses in the sampled window. I did not see the flag change itself or any event that applied it, and Jaeger returned no traces for this window, so the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: For service frontend, the ERROR-status span increases switched from 0 in the 00:13:16–00:18:16 300 s bucket to 233.3 per 300 s for span_name "GET /api/data" and 233.3 for span_name "grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds" in 00:18:16–00:23:16, 222.7 in 00:23:16–00:28:16, and back to 0 with 114.0 UNSET spans in 00:28:16–00:33:16.

At 120 s resolution the frontend's ERROR spans per 300 s rose from 4.66 (GET /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds) at 00:20:16 to 166.7 at 00:22:16, 291.1 at 00:24:16, 295.6 at 00:26:16, 222.7 at 00:28:16, 104.5 at 00:30:16 and 0 at 00:32:16; POST /api/checkout ERROR spans were 6.99 (00:20:16), 86.7 (00:22:16), 80 (00:24:16) then 0 from 00:26:16; frontend tcp.connect ERROR spans were 3.5, 14.4, 11.1, 4.4, 2.3 and 0 over the same steps.

ConfigMap flagd-config in namespace otel-demo (data key demo.flagd.json) sets flag "adFailure" to defaultVariant "on" (description "Fail ad service", state ENABLED) and flag "paymentUnreachable" to defaultVariant "on" (description "Payment service is unavailable", state ENABLED); adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak (0), imageSlowLoad (0), kafkaQueueProblems (0), loadGeneratorFloodHomepage (0), paymentFailure (0), productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure are all "off".

The ad and payment Deployments were rolled out with unchanged pod templates: new ReplicaSets ad-5f8dd7c58d (created 2026-11-18T00:18:24Z) and payment-5d565cf9b (created 2026-11-18T00:18:23Z) carry pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt 2026-11-18T00:18:24Z and 2026-11-18T00:18:23Z, and their container image and env (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad / 2.1.3-payment, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013) are identical to the old ReplicaSets ad-554b849958 and payment-55766d76b9, which are scaled to spec.replicas 0.

Namespace otel-demo events at 00:18:23–00:18:27 are Normal ScalingReplicaSet on Deployments ad ("Scaled up replica set ad-5f8dd7c58d from 0 to 1", "Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0") and payment ("Scaled up replica set payment-5d565cf9b from 0 to 1", "Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0"), with ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete and Pod Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started for ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 and payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn and Killing of the old ad and payment pods.

Pods ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 (started 2026-11-18T00:18:24Z) and payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn (started 2026-11-18T00:18:23Z) are Running with ready=true and restartCount 0, and frontend-675fd7b5c5-68tcg has been Running since 2026-11-17T23:45:36Z with restartCount 0.

The checkout service's own spans show ERROR status only in the 00:18:16–00:23:16 bucket: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge each increased 78.7 per 900 s, with 0 in the 00:23:16–00:28:16 and 00:28:16–00:33:16 buckets, while their STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans (131.1, 179.6, 76.8 per 900 s) continued.

The payment service's own spans show 0 ERROR status for span_name GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect in every 900 s bucket between 00:23:16 and 00:38:16, and the payment container log shows "Charge request received." followed by "Transaction complete." for each request between 00:27:46 and 00:28:05, while checkout logs "payment went through" between 00:27:20 and 00:28:05.
frontend-proxy has its own ERROR span series that rose from 0–2.5 per 300 s in the buckets from 23:30 to 00:20 to 34.4 at the 00:20:00 bucket, 560.9 at 00:25:00 and 206.6 at 00:30:00.

The ad service shows its own small error spans on flagd evaluation: flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean ERROR and UNSET each 1.33 per 900 s in the 00:28:16 and 00:33:16 windows, and flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream ERROR 1.03 in the 00:18:16–00:23:16 window, while its server spans for oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, getAdsByCategory and getRandomAds carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET only.

The restarted ad instance (exported_instance 6fdd384a-06c6-45aa-956a-83b4df612a1c) served 149.3 GetAds spans per 900 s at 00:33:16, of which 119.0 were <=1000 ms, 134.7 <=15000 ms and 149.3 <=+Inf, i.e. about 15 spans (10%) took longer than 15 s; the pre-restart instance (7d4b419f-8ff2-434f-80db-30cf764f86bc) served 627.9 GetAds spans in the 00:23:16 window with all of them <=1000 ms.

CPU throttling rose on the restarted pods: container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total rate for ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 was 2.71/s, 9.96/s, 10.00/s, 3.68/s and 0.19/s at 00:18–00:31 versus 0.18–0.83/s on ad-554b849958, and for payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn 2.38/s, 6.59/s, 2.55/s and 1.25/s versus 0.57–1.23/s on payment-55766d76b9; ad container CPU usage reached 0.0488–0.0491 cores against its 50m CPU limit.

The ad container log between 00:27:57 and 00:28:11 shows normal request handling lines such as "Targeted ad request received for [travel]" and "Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response."

For the window 00:08:16–00:38:16 the span-status query returned only STATUS_CODE_UNSET or STATUS_CODE_OK series for cart, currency, email, product-catalog, quote and shipping, and only about 1 ERROR span per 900 s for recommendation (1.03–1.13) and fraud-detection (1.03 then 0).

The fraud-detection container has restartCount 1 with lastState terminated reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 2026-11-18T00:20:10Z, and the pod was re-created container-side at 00:20:11 while the Deployment object itself is at generation 1.

The switched-on fault-injection settings in ConfigMap flagd-config (adFailure="on" = "Fail ad service" and paymentUnreachable="on" = "Payment service is unavailable") are the cause of the frontend alert: the ad and payment rollout restarts at 00:18:23–00:18:24 with unchanged pod templates are the mechanism by which the fault was applied to pods that read flags from flagd, and the observed frontend GET /api/data + grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds ERROR spans and the transient POST /api/checkout and checkout PaymentService/Charge ERROR spans are its consequences.

A second open candidate is CPU starvation of the restarted ad container (50m CPU limit, throttled-period rate ~10/s, GetAds tail of ~15 spans >15 s per instance per 900 s) contributing to frontend ad-call failures; this remains unresolved and is weaker than the fault-flag explanation because the /api/data failure fraction was ~79% (233.3 ERROR vs 63.3 UNSET per 300 s in 00:18:16–00:23:16) while only ~10% of ad server spans were slow, and it does not explain the separate checkout/payment-path errors.

Surface state of the named dependencies is not itself broken: ad and payment pods are Running/ready with restartCount 0, payment records 0 ERROR spans of its own and its log shows successful "Transaction complete." charges at 00:27–00:28, ad logs normal "Targeted ad request received" lines, and ad's GetAds server spans carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET rather than ERROR — so the failures are behaviour-level (flag-driven), not pod crashes.

The other fault-injection settings in the same ConfigMap are rejected as the switched-on setting behind this incident: adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak (0), imageSlowLoad (0), kafkaQueueProblems (0), loadGeneratorFloodHomepage (0), paymentFailure (0), productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure all read "off" in flagd-config.

Advisory: confirm whether adFailure and paymentUnreachable are meant to be enabled in ConfigMap flagd-config; if not, returning those flag variants to "off" is the change that should stop the ad-call and checkout failures, and the frontend error rate should be re-checked afterwards.

Advisory: review the ad container's 50m CPU limit and the throttling/latency tail seen on the restarted ad pod, and restore trace visibility (Jaeger returned no traces for 00:10–00:38) so that error messages and call edges for the failing GetAds calls can be inspected.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so I could not see who or what changed the flagd-config values, when adFailure and paymentUnreachable were switched on, or who issued the rollout restarts recorded by kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:18:23Z/00:18:24Z; the declared fault itself was not observed happening.

Jaeger returned no traces at all for frontend, ad and checkout in 00:10:00–00:38:16 (traces_search / traces_search_by_tags returned no_data), so span-level error messages, status descriptions and parent-child call edges for the failing GetAds and PlaceOrder/Charge calls are unknown.

The Prometheus target has no alerting rules loaded (queries for rule_name RequestErrorRate and type=alert returned no data), so the RequestErrorRate expression and the reported value 4.422222222222222 could not be verified; the available series in the window were span metrics and container/kube metrics only (no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count, rpc_* or app_payment_transactions_total series appeared).

ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans carry no status (STATUS_CODE_UNSET), so whether the ad service actually returned the gRPC errors that frontend's GetAds client spans report could not be observed directly.
The frontend container produced no log lines in the read window, so frontend-side runtime error text is unknown.

The fraud-detection container was OOMKilled (exitCode 137) at 2026-11-18T00:20:10Z and restarted; no evidence ties that restart to the flagd fault settings or to the frontend alert, and its cause is unplaced.

ad/payment file-level spec history and the exact content of the previous (pre-00:18) versions of flagd-config could not be read, because Kubernetes objects show only their state at query time and ConfigMap change events were not recorded in the event window.
next_steps: Check the change history / audit trail for ConfigMap flagd-config and for the ad and payment Deployment rollout-restart annotations at 2026-11-18T00:18:23–00:18:24Z to identify who or what applied them.

If the fault injection was unintended, revert adFailure and paymentUnreachable to "off" in flagd-config and verify the frontend RequestErrorRate and the frontend GET /api/data / grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans return to zero.

Restore or extend Jaeger retention/sampling for the otel-demo namespace so that error spans for grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge can be inspected with their status messages.
Review the ad container's 50m CPU limit and its CFS throttling on the restarted pod, and compare GetAds latency after the incident window settles.

data.relay:
connectors:
  spanmetrics:
    dimensions:
    - default: otel-demo
      name: namespace
exporters:
  clickhouse:
    endpoint: http://clickhouse-clickhouse.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local:8123
    logs_table_name: otel_demo_logs
    password: ""
    traces_table_name: otel_demo_traces
    username: default
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch-master.opensearch.svc.cluster.local:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel-logs
    logs_index_time_format: yyyy-MM-dd
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector.opentelemetry-collectors.svc.cluster.local:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    endpoint: http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090
    tls:
      insecure: true
  prometheus:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8889
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  resourcedetection:
    detectors:
    - env
    - system
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  nginx:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: http://image-provider:8081/status
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  postgresql:
    endpoint: postgresql:5432
    metrics:
      postgresql.blks_hit:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.blks_read:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.deadlocks:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_deleted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_fetched:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_inserted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_returned:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_updated:
        enabled: true
    password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
    tls:
      insecure: true
    username: root
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
    username: valkey
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - debug
      - prometheus
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - nginx
      - otlp
      - postgresql
      - redis
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - pull:
          exporter:
            prometheus:
              host: 0.0.0.0
              port: 8888
